Alex Kim: Hey team — first day! I think I'm missing a few things: HubSpot CRM, Gong, access to the sales playbook in Notion, and the call recordings folder. Can someone point me to the right request flow? :wave:
Samir Patel: Welcome Alex :tada: Pinged Sales Ops and IT. Quick checklist in case it helps:
1) Okta invite
2) HubSpot seat
3) Gong license
4) Notion space access
5) Sales collateral folder
Maria Ortiz: Hi Alex — filing this now. Please fill the access form: https://forms.redwood.com/sales-access (share your preferred email, manager, and seat type). Also for Gong send me your email and whether you need transcription enabled.
IT Helpdesk: Ticket created #INC-2024-9876 for HubSpot/Gong/Notion. Okta invite sent to alex.kim@redwood.com — check spam. If you don't see it, run:
```
okta verify --resend alex.kim@redwood.com
```
Alex Kim: Thanks Samir/Maria! I filled the form (submitted). Email is alex.kim@redwood.com. Do I need VPN for Private deployment demos?
Jonas Lee: Nope VPN not required for demo data. For customer-only private infra we do a different process — we'll loop infra if needed. Welcome aboard :rocket:
Maria Ortiz: Gong note: once we add you, you'll get onboarding emails from Gong with links to schedule a 30min session. HubSpot: you'll have 'Sales Rep' role. Notion playbook: https://redwood.notion.site/Sales-Playbook-d8f7 — Start with 'First Week > Call Scripts'
Samir Patel: If you want quick collateral, go to Drive -> Sales -> Playbooks -> '2026-Quarterly-Decks'. I'll share a pinned copy here in a minute.
Alex Kim: Got the Okta invite and Gong email. HubSpot seat still pending. Also can't access the 'Call Recordings' drive folder (permission denied).
IT Helpdesk: Grant applied for Drive folder 'Call Recordings' — you should have access in ~15 mins. If not, run `gdrive share --user alex.kim@redwood.com --folder 'Call Recordings'` and paste output here.
Maria Ortiz: HubSpot seat assigned — you should be able to login now. If you hit the 'insufficient permissions' error, click 'Request Access' and tag me.
Alex Kim: Logging in now... HubSpot OK! Gong onboarding session scheduled for 3/15. Thanks everyone :heart:
